claim_ceiling: No artifact may assert that a map helps a jurist, that any authority is absent from the corpus, that any frozen bar is met or moved, or that any packet is fit to serve. Usefulness remains the human product gate's question and admission remains fail-closed. Concept-coverage counts are lexical coverage of a retrieved set, not a legal conclusion, and a zero count is a retrieval signal, not proof of corpus absence.
disclosure_text_for_product_if_ever_reco: The measured deterministic expansion layer (bare mined-term queries) did not recover the missing frozen controlling authorities in FR/IT nor the two zero-coverage German concepts on de-kapitalverletzung, and its added searches breached the frozen per-search latency budget (up to 83.5s against <30s). This is a retrieval signal about this query shape, not proof that the authorities or concepts are absent from the corpus. The admission-disclosure half of the original finding remains with Product; usefulness remains the human product gate's question and admission remains fail-closed.
drop_in_path: product.query.pipeline.enrich_query_bundle (after initial retrieval, before rerank) - unchanged from v1; the seam is additive-only and regression-proven
item_disposition: CLOSED per charter stop rule at OUTCOME_B: the measured candidate layer does not meet the promotion bar and no further threshold, lexicon or prompt tuning is permitted under this charter. This contract is the handoff record for Product; it does NOT recommend adopting the measured layer as-is.

measured_layer_spec.query_shape_emitted: ONE bare mined-vocabulary term list (<=12 tokens) per (question, target language)

measured_outcome.one_bounded_cause: TERM-ONLY EXPANSION QUERIES ARE TOO NARROW FOR THE OPENCASELAW RELEVANCE INDEX. Each A1 search sent a bare mined-vocabulary term list (up to 12 tokens) with no natural-language question text, while every accepted baseline query is a full sentence and returned 50/50 results. Measured on the committed cache: the de-kapitalverletzung expansion returned HTTP 200 with 0 rows, the fr-bail-entretien expansion 1 row, and the corporate-criminal-liability::fr expansion 0 rows; across all measurable (leg, language) cells the candidate-only channel recovered 0 of 9 missing frozen authority ids.
measured_outcome.what_this_does_not_claim: it does not claim the corpus lacks these authorities; a retrieval miss is a retrieval signal, not proof of absence

runtime_cost.expansion_mining: string operations only; <5 ms; zero model calls; zero network at construction

retrieval_cost.budget_breach_named: PER-SEARCH BUDGET BREACHED: the candidate layer's added searches took up to 83.5s against a frozen <30.0s per-search limit (10 of 15 added calls over budget, measured sum 600.6s); a cached replay costs no network but does not make the original call cheaper, so this is a property of the layer and not of the replay

structural_finding.note: this is computable from the accepted baseline with no candidate at all: a question with zero under-covered concepts cannot be reduced further
structural_finding.outcome_a_coverage_bar: reduce under_covered on at least 2 of 3 served questions

vacuity_adjudication_summary: the blanked control tied the candidate because the candidate recovered nothing (true null). Harness responsiveness is proven independently: the A1 channel moved the pooled row count on 12 of 15 cells, the A3 shuffled control passed on every served question, and regression_suite.py test_metric_sensitivity_non_vacuity registers injected concept and authority-id improvements on the frozen metrics.
